strings.trade_inventory_held: Burrow is holding your inventory for an unfinished transfer. Wait for it to finish, then try trading again.
strings.trade_recovery_requested: Asking the host to resolve your pending trade.
strings.trade_recovery_resolved: Trade recovery confirmed by the host.
strings.trade_recovery_uncertain: The trade outcome is still uncertain. Your items and recovery records have been kept. Ask the host for help.
strings.trade_recovery_help: Ask the host to confirm this receipt. Barter retries a proven outcome without repeating the item exchange. An uncertain exchange stays blocked to protect your items.
strings.sell_buyback_too_large: This sale has too much item data for buyback. Try selling fewer items.
strings.trade_unavailable: This trade cannot be completed safely. Reopen the trader and try again. If it stays unavailable, ask the host to check Barter's log.
strings.step_aside: Barter stays off while {0} is installed. Remove {0} to use Barter's trader lists and purse.
strings.purse_tip: A poor trader charges more and pays less. A rich one charges less and pays more. The purse refills each morning.
strings.sell_empty: Nothing you carry sells to this trader
strings.sell_no_room: No room in your inventory for the payment
strings.sell_tip: Pick an item to see what the trader pays. The button sells one lot.
strings.lists_rejected: Trade lists were not applied: {0} The previous lists stay in force.
strings.service_authority_only: Buyback and repair require the host's local character; remote inventory cannot be verified.
strings.controller_help: D-pad right: sell list. Up/down: select. A: sell. X: filter. Y: services. Left: buy list. B: close store.
strings.epicloot_panel: Barter's sell panel is hidden while Epic Loot adventure mode is active to avoid covering its interface. Trader services remain available.
strings.buyback_empty: No sold items available for buyback
strings.buyback_help: Buy back your exact sold items for the original payout before the next in-game day. Server rules apply.
strings.repair_help: Repair carried equipment for this trader's currency. The server checks eligibility and price.
strings.editor_help: Host or admin only. Saving validates all lists and writes to the host. Other players receive the new lists immediately.
strings.editor_invalid: Invalid list. Check fields, item names, currency and quality.
strings.editor_failed: Save refused or unconfirmed. Reopen to reload the current lists before trying again.
strings.editor_large: This file is too large for the in-game editor. Edit it on the host or through Almanac.
strings.editor_unsaved: Unsaved changes. Save, or close and reopen to discard them before changing files.
strings.cfg_trader_services__buyback_enabled_hel: Host/server: keep exact sold items available to the seller until the next in-game day. Buyback costs the original payout.
strings.cfg_trader_services__repair_enabled_help: Host/server: let traders repair carried equipment for their currency. The server checks eligibility and prices.
strings.cfg_trader_services__repair_base_price_h: Host/server: price for fully damaged quality-one gear, scaled by quality, missing durability and the trader's buy price.
strings.cfg_interface__price_tips_help: Each player: show the current trader's effective buy and sell quotes in item tooltips. Prices may change before trading.
strings.trade_recovery_pending: Trade recovery is required. Receipt: {0}. Recovery files: {1}.
strings.trade_recovery_unreadable: Trade recovery files could not be read. Recovery files: {0}.
strings.cfg_interface__hide_equipped_items_help: Each player: hide unequipped hotbar gear from the sell list. Equipped gear and protected extra slots are always kept.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__enabled_help: Traders that have a Barter list (Haldor, Hildir and the Bog Witch with the shipped lists, Custom Traders, and any trader you write a list for) have a limited balance that goes down when they pay you and up when you buy, and refills each morning. Other mods' traders keep the game's prices.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__flexible_pricing_help: Prices follow the trader's balance: a poor trader charges more and pays less, a rich one the opposite.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__minimum_balance_help: The balance a trader starts with and never refills below; prices are neutral at this balance.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__maximum_balance_help: The balance a trader refills up to; prices reach the discount and the markup at this balance.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__daily_increase_help: How much a trader's balance grows at each refill, up to the maximum.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__daily_decrease_help: How much a balance above the maximum shrinks at each refill, down to the maximum.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__discount_help: The price you pay at the maximum balance, as a factor (0.7 is 30 percent off); also what an empty purse pays you.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__markup_help: The price you pay at an empty purse, as a factor (1.5 is 50 percent more); also what a full purse pays you.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__replenish_days_help: How many in-game days pass between refills of a trader's balance.
strings.cfg_trader_purse__replenish_message_help: Tell everyone in the morning when trader balances were refilled.
strings.cfg_trade_lists__sell_only_discovered_he: A trader does not offer items you have not discovered yet.
strings.cfg_trade_lists__always_offered_help: Comma list of item prefabs a trader offers even when you have not discovered them. Items the game's own traders sell are always included.
strings.cfg_trade_lists__disable_vanilla_items_h: Remove the game's own items from trader buy lists, so only Barter's lists remain. Progress purchases such as inventory rows stay.
strings.cfg_trade_lists__disable_other_mods_item: Remove items other mods added to trader buy lists before Barter adds its own.
strings.cfg_trade_lists__quality_price_multiplie: Extra price per quality level above one when you sell gear, as a share of the listed price (0.5 adds half per level). 0 ignores quality.
strings.cfg_trade_lists__common_valuables_help: Every item the game gives a value can be sold to any trader at that value, unless a Sell list prices it.
strings.cfg_trade_lists__custom_traders_help: Comma list of extra trader prefab names (case sensitive in the game) that get a balance and use Barter's lists.
strings.cfg_trade_lists__trader_currencies_help: Comma list of Trader:Currency pairs, for example Haldor:Coins,Hildir:SilverCoin. The item is that trader's currency unless a list entry names its own.
strings.cfg_interface__sell_panel_help: Show the sell list beside the trader's window.
strings.cfg_interface__show_purse_help: Show the trader's balance, currency and price change beside the trader's window.
